content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free static site hosting service built on GitHub’s infrastructure. It serves HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files directly from a public repository. For digital creators, this means zero hosting costs, global CDN delivery via Cloudflare, and no server management. Paired with crypto payment processing, it becomes a sovereign commerce stack. No platform owns your customer data. No fees erode your margins. You deploy once, own forever. This architecture is not a workaround — it’s base-layer infrastructure designed for creators in regions where conventional payment gateways are blocked or extractive.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates in three layers. First, GitHub Pages hosts your product catalog as static files. Second, a backend script (Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Worker) verifies crypto payments via NOWPayments API. Third, upon payment confirmation, the script generates a secure, expiring download link for your digital product. All customer data is stored in a Supabase database or Google Sheet. File delivery happens via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The system is stateless, serverless, and fully automated. You load products once, and the stack handles sales, payment verification, and delivery without human intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is for creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and similar platforms are unavailable or cost-prohibitive. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Venezuela, this stack gives you infrastructure sovereignty. It’s also for creators who refuse to pay 10% platform fees. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, switching from Gumroad to NOWPayments retains $921 more revenue. This is not a temporary fix — it’s a permanent commerce stack you own outright.
GitHub Pages + NOWPayments = 99.5% revenue retention.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages provides free hosting with global CDN. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic for payment verification and file delivery. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook integration. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 hosts product files. The stack is modular: swap components as needed. For example, use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks for transaction fees under $0.10. Every piece is free or low-cost, and you control the entire system after deployment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by forking the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack template on GitHub. Customize the product catalog HTML. Connect your NOWPayments API key for crypto payment processing. Deploy to GitHub Pages with one click. Test the end-to-end flow using testnet crypto. Once verified, load your products into the system. Share your store URL globally. The stack is live within 48 hours. For advanced configurations, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, saving you $348 compared to purchasing separately. Deploy once, sell forever — no platform dependence.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, use GitHub Pages for free hosting, NOWPayments for crypto processing, and Google Apps Script for automated file delivery. This stack eliminates platform fees and geographic restrictions. Deploy the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack in 48 hours. Load your ebook, set your price in USD, and accept 300+ cryptocurrencies. The system verifies payments on-chain, generates secure download links, and delivers your product instantly. You keep 99.5% of every sale.
Deploy once, own forever — no platform dependence.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, this same architecture applies. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints for all 6 stacks and 7 templates, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Whether you’re selling fonts in Bangladesh or software in Zimbabwe, the principles are the same: own your infrastructure, eliminate platform fees, and accept global crypto payments. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack or deploy the Edge Commerce Stack for advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration.
Your Deployment Checklist

Fork the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack template from GitHub. Customize the product catalog HTML with your branding and pricing. Connect your NOWPayments API key for crypto payment processing. Deploy the site to GitHub Pages with one click. Test the payment flow using testnet crypto. Load your digital products into the system via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Share your live store URL globally. For advanced features, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC using the Edge Commerce Stack blueprint. Monitor sales via Supabase dashboard or Google Sheets. Scale by adding more products or upgrading to the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The COREMERCH stacks are designed for non-developers. The Sovereign Starter Stack uses no-code tools like Google Apps Script. Follow the blueprint step-by-step, and deploy in 48 hours. For advanced features, the Edge Commerce Stack requires basic JavaScript knowledge.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON. Transaction fees are under $0.10. Customers pay in their preferred currency, and you receive USD equivalent at the time of payment.
How secure is the file delivery system?

The system generates secure, expiring download links for each purchase. Files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. No one can access your products without paying. The stack is designed to prevent unauthorized sharing.
What happens if crypto prices fluctuate?

NOWPayments converts crypto payments to USD at the time of transaction. You receive the exact USD amount you set. Price volatility does not affect your revenue. Customers bear any crypto price fluctuations.
Can I scale this stack to thousands of sales?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack uses Cloudflare Workers and Supabase for scalability. Upgrade to the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for the scaling playbook. The architecture is stateless and serverless, handling any volume without additional costs.
BSC, Solana, TRON: Transaction fees under $0.10.
